evidence: Modifies `BufferedWriter` in `src/streams.h` to avoid throwing destructors and properly handle buffered stream flush failures.
rationale: Fixes a crash caused by throwing destructors in `BufferedWriter`. Because `BufferedWriter`'s destructor was implicitly non-throwing, unflushed write failures (such as running out of disk space) threw `std::ios_base::failure` and invoked `std::terminate`, preventing clean shutdown.
